title: Refactor fuzz generator into C-subset program generator
description: The current BNF expander mostly stitches fixed template fragments together, so generated programs do not exercise variable scope, expression composition, reusable declarations, or realistic statement interactions. Refactor fuzzing around a C-aware program generator that can consume a grammar/BNF for the supported syntax but also maintain generation state: declared variables, types, scopes, functions, globals, and expression contexts. The generator should produce valid C programs for Slate's supported subset, with variables that can be declared, assigned, read, passed to functions, used in array indices, struct/union fields, loops, sizeof, volatile/static contexts where supported, and combined into expressions/statements without violating C validity. The design should be closer to a small csmith-style generator for our subset than a pure random text expander. It should keep deterministic seeds, shrinking/debuggability where practical, and integrate with the existing differential test harness and BNF fuzz entry point. Acceptance criteria: design is documented; generator can emit multi-function programs with scoped variables and expressions; generated programs compile as C and translate with Slate; differential tests run multiple seeds; existing simple BNF tests are either preserved as smoke tests or migrated cleanly.
notes: Refactoring tests/bnf_fuzz.rs fuzzing around a stateful C-subset generator (tests/support/cgen.rs). Keeps BNF grammar+expander as a smoke test; new generator_differential runs multiple seeds. Value-bound tracking guarantees no i32 overflow / OOB so C==Rust.
close_reason: Refactored fuzzing around a stateful C-subset generator (tests/support/cgen.rs): scope/type env + function-signature state compose multi-function programs with scoped vars, expressions, calls; value-bound tracking guarantees no UB so C==Rust. BNF expander kept as bnf_expander_smoke; generator_differential runs N seeds (40 verified green). Design in docs/fuzzing.md. All tests + fmt pass.

Verified with cargo fmt, cargo run --quiet -- emit-fixtures, cargo test -- --nocapture, and git diff --check.

close_reason: Implemented file-scope static int globals by collecting integer cir.global definitions, emitting Rust static mut items, and lowering get_global loads/stores to unsafe static access. Added static_globals.c fixture, generated-Rust shape assertion, BNF fuzz coverage, and docs. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo run --quiet -- emit-fixtures, cargo test -- --nocapture, and git diff --check.

title: Remove unsound struct derives
description: Struct lowering should not derive Clone, Copy, or Default without proving every field supports those traits.
close_reason: Removed unsound Clone/Copy/Default derives from generated structs and kept explicit field initialization. Verified with cargo fmt, cargo run --quiet -- emit-fixtures, and cargo test -- --nocapture.

title: Support integer modulo (cir.rem)
description: cir.rem is unhandled. Lower as Rust '%' (truncated remainder, sign of dividend, matching C) for both signed and unsigned. Generator must keep divisors nonzero. Extend grammar arith_op with '%'. Add fixtures and fuzzer coverage.

title: Support integer division (cir.div)
description: cir.div is unhandled. Lower as Rust '/' (truncates toward zero, matching C) for both signed and unsigned. Generator must keep divisors nonzero and avoid INT_MIN/-1 (both UB in C). Add fixtures and fuzzer coverage.

title: Support integer multiplication (cir.mul)
description: cir.mul is unhandled. Lower as Rust '*' for signed and wrapping_mul for unsigned. Keep generated programs well-defined (bounded so no signed overflow). Add fixtures and fuzzer coverage.

title: Support integer subtraction (cir.sub)
description: cir.sub is unhandled and falls through to todo!, breaking any program using binary '-'. Lower it as Rust '-' for signed and wrapping_sub for unsigned (C unsigned underflow wraps; Rust '-' panics in debug). Add fixtures and fuzzer coverage.

title: Support typedef aliases
description: Add C typedef support so aliased type names resolve to their underlying supported types. Prerequisite for stdint.h fixed-width types and idiomatic C.

title: Support non-int parameters, return types, and globals
description: BNF restricts <param>, <ret_type> (int/void), and <global_decl> to int. Allow float/double/char/etc. as parameter, return, and file-scope global types across the grammar and lowering.

title: Support struct/union fields of non-int types
description: The BNF <field> is hardcoded to 'int <ident>'. Allow struct/union fields of other supported types (float, double, char, pointers, nested aggregates) in both the grammar and lowering.

title: Support array-type declarations
description: Add array *type* declarations (T name[N]) to the grammar and lowering. Docs mention fixed-size local int arrays with indexed access, but there is no array-type declaration production in the BNF, and only int element types.

title: Support pointer types
description: Add C pointer types (T*). No pointer type production exists in the BNF and no pointer lowering. Includes pointer declarations, dereference, address-of, and pointer arithmetic. Foundational for many other features.

title: Support fixed-width stdint.h types (int8_t, uint32_t, size_t, ...)
description: Add support for <stdint.h>/<stddef.h> fixed-width and size types (int8_t, uint32_t, size_t, etc.). These resolve through typedefs to CIR integer widths; requires typedef handling and header resolution.

title: Support _Bool / bool
description: Add C _Bool (bool) type, mapped to Rust bool, including conversions from comparisons and integer contexts.

title: Support long / unsigned long

close_reason: Wired short/unsigned int/long/long long into fixtures (shorts.c, unsigned.c, longs.c, longlong.c), the differential fuzzer (emit_wideint_use), grammar, and docs. Generic CIR width mapper already handled s16/u16/s32/u32/s64/u64; additionally fixed unsigned overflow to lower as wrapping_add so defined C wrap matches Rust.
